newsitem.title: UK: Details about Guinness, Grand Metropolitan.
newsitem.headline: Details about Guinness, Grand Metropolitan.

text.p: Following are details about Grand Metropolitan Plc, the owner of Burger King and Pillsbury foods in the United States, and Guinness Plc, which announced a $15.8 billion merger Monday, the biggest ever in Britain.

Formed in 1759 in Dublin, Ireland, Guinness spent 230 years as a brewer before expanding into the world of spirits, acquiring brands such as Johnnie Walker and Bell's Scotch whisky, Draught Guinness and Moet & Chandon champagne.
One of Britain's largest food and drinks producers, Grand Met has made more than 30 acquisitions in the last decade, including the 1989 purchase of Pillsbury for $5.7 billion.
NOTE: Financial results computed at current exchange rates.
